Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.collectBody: Global Connect uses Contentful to store content and Clerk to manage accounts. We only collect the information you provide when you sign in, and basic usage data needed to keep the site running.
Privacy.useBody: Your details are used to personalise community features — like registering for sessions — and to keep the service secure. We never sell your data.
Privacy.choicesBody: You can ask to see or delete your data at any time by contacting us at the address on the About page.

Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.usingBody: Global Connect connects young people with international opportunities. We aim to keep listings accurate, but always confirm details on official programme pages before applying.
Terms.contentBody: Opportunity listings and guides are provided for informational purposes. We are not responsible for the application outcomes of third-party programmes we share.
Terms.conductBody: Be kind. Harassment, spam or misleading content leads to account removal. Community members are expected to treat each other with respect.
